item.title: Eventbrite Adds Autocomplete to Search Events
item.description:
Eventbrite Adds Autocomplete to Search Events

Eventbrite introduced an autocomplete capability for its Search events function.

🔍 Overview

  • New autocomplete appears in the Search events workflow.

🛠️ Features

  • Search events
  • autocomplete
  • Find my tickets
  • Sign in
  • Find Events
  • Create Events
  • Solutions
  • Event Ticketing
  • Event Marketing Platform
  • Eventbrite Ads
  • Payments

📂 Supported Industries

  • Music
  • Food & Beverage
  • Performing Arts
  • Charity & Causes
  • Retail

🎫 Event Types

  • Concerts
  • Classes & Workshops
  • Festivals & Fairs
  • Conferences
  • Corporate Events
  • Online Events

🚀 Release

  • Announced at the Oct 8 – MCP/Agents/Skills Meetup, an online event hosted by Voxel51.
  • The meetup took place on Thursday, October 8, 9 AM – 11 AM PDT.
  • Sales ended for the event on Thu, Oct 8, 9 AM PDT.

Source: Oct 8 - MCP/Agents/Skills Meetup

item.title: Eventbrite Event Combines Claude and Instagram for Clients
item.description:
Eventbrite Event Combines Claude and Instagram for Clients

A new event is being promoted on Eventbrite that combines the AI tool Claude with the social media platform Instagram to attract clients.

🔍 Overview

An Eventbrite listing titled “CLAUDE + INSTAGRAM = CLIENTS” has been published. The event is organized by Tamara Larisa Tyrbouslu, Global Property Seminars and is scheduled to take place in Las Vegas, Nevada.

📅 Key Details

  • Event title: CLAUDE + INSTAGRAM = CLIENTS
  • Organizer: Tamara Larisa Tyrbouslu, Global Property Seminars
  • Location: 5598 S Fort Apache Rd, Las Vegas, NV
  • Date/Time: Friday, October 2 • 10 AM - 12 PM
